title: Canonical integral scalar comparison respects fibre paths
statement: The existing integral scalar fibre comparison is a natural isomorphism between the actual integral fibre functors. It has the exact finite-level germ formula for every scalar coefficient. For every integral transport with the finite-level evaluation formula, this comparison intertwines the integral paths for each inclusion E into L. Definitions and hypotheses are those of [new-e5-integral-fibre-path-construction], [lem-pod-lisse-integral-scalar-fiber-isomorphism].

source.place: Weil II (1.1.1) b)-d), pp.146-147; explicit part of the fibre transport argument

proof.text: Use the existing naturality and isomorphism of the integral scalar fibre map to build the natural isomorphism. Its unit is the comparison applied to the scalar adjunction unit.

The scalar unit on a finite-level sheaf sends each section to 1 tensor that section. Apply the stalk germ formula and linearity to obtain every scalar b. To prove the path square, use adjunction injectivity, compare all inverse-limit projections, and use path naturality for the underlying set scalar unit. The given evaluation formula identifies these projections with the finite-set path square.

theorem integralFibreScalarIso_path (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [IsNoetherian Y] [Y.IsSeparated] [∀ x : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField x)]
    (Q : Type (u + 1)) [Field Q] [Algebra ℚ_[l] Q] [IsAlgClosure ℚ_[l] Q]
    (i : IntegralFibrePathTransport l Y Q)
    {Ωy : Type u} [Field Ωy] [IsAlgClosed Ωy] (y : Spec (.of Ωy) ⟶ Y)
    {Ωz : Type u} [Field Ωz] [IsAlgClosed Ωz] (z : Spec (.of Ωz) ⟶ Y)
    (t : flcFiber y ≅ flcFiber z) (E L : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Q) (h : E ≤ L)
    (F : LisseIntegralSheaf l E.val Y) :
    (ModuleCat.ringExtendScalars.{u + 1, u + 1}
      (lisseIntegerInclusion l E.val L.val (IntermediateField.inclusion h))).map
        (((i.linear E).map y z t).hom.app F) ≫
        (integralFibreScalarIso l Y z E.val L.val (IntermediateField.inclusion h)).hom.app F =
      (integralFibreScalarIso l Y y E.val L.val (IntermediateField.inclusion h)).hom.app F ≫
        ((i.linear L).map y z t).hom.app
          ((lisseIntegralScalarExtension l E.val Y L.val
            (IntermediateField.inclusion h)).obj F)
